svg.text: Pencilled in: where each planned piece lands (plan numbers from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-zetasdr-plan-series.md, gists from TODO.md)

text.tspan: Web UI only. Staircase transcript ribbons (lanes from the pixel
height between channels); mode picking by band through
knowledge_lookup with a search fallback; state-stream decoders
such as ADS-B as one held line per subject; the Okudagram
zeta-dsp. A bits stream kind; fsk/psk/ook demod stages,
clock_recover, slicer (eye and constellation stats), bit_view
(run lengths, autocorrelation, sync-word and CRC hypotheses),
library) + thin Modbus RTU / DNP3 / IEC-101/104 rows; signature
write-back to knowledge; burst-aware measure (duty, burst_ms,
Rows and small stages on the plan-17 frameworks: M17 (Codec 2)
and DMR (AMBE via mbelib, tools/install-vocoders.sh) as audio
rows feeding transcribe; AIS (nmea parser, map), FLEX;
whole-span POCSAG/APRS as a watch with decode_on capture;
stereo wfm_demod with pilot level; DFM/M20 synthesised tests;
sink stage kinds for the standard feeds (APRS-IS, SBS/Beast,
AIS NMEA, PSK Reporter, WSPRnet, KISS TNC); a generic sink:
{kind, params} on the watch's detect node replacing the one-off
sondehub field (shorthand kept); fixes: a sink-bearing decoder
frozen as an operator graph, gated_stop cleared by a sink
A provider over acma-local (the RRL as SQLite / MCP) answering
knowledge_lookup with licensee, site, distance, power and
decoded emission designator for assignments in the band near
--station LAT,LON, so classify's layer 2 can say 'a licensed
16K0F1D link 12 km away' before anyone demodulates. Register
Re-centre before identifying (power-weighted centroid over the
run's bins, or a slow high-pass ahead of the WAV feed: rs41mod
decodes only within ±1 kHz); detect defaults that hold on a
real receiver (threshold vs median, min run energy, signal
event rate limit); sonde rows before ACARS on a 12.5 kHz FSK
box; classify tries a row-width slice at the measured centre.
True block timestamps (HackRF drift bug) to unlock UTC-slotted
modes (FT8/FT4, WSPR) and TDMA (DMR, TETRA); a trunking
follower (P25, DMR Tier III, MPT1327) starting voice jobs from
control-channel events inside a pin; decoders that find their
own channels in a capture; wideband modes (DVB-T, DAB) on the
GPU FFT, parked behind the HackRF-first set.
snap/flatpak/AppImage install hints; the vocoder install script
and its legal note; layer 3 (a learned classifier) stays an
empty slot until layer-4 sessions produce labelled captures;
field craft additions: knowledge first on licensed bands, burst
timing over 'noise', an unknown-signal playbook that stops at
